children.content:
# ☸️ Complete Kubernetes (K8s) & Cloud-Native Architecture Track

Welcome to your full Kubernetes learning workspace materialized with **Trak**.

## 📚 Comprehensive Module Index

| Module | Title | Key Topics Covered |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-cluster-architecture` | **Cluster Architecture** | Control Plane (API server, etcd, scheduler, controller-mgr), Worker Nodes (kubelet, kube-proxy, CRI), `kubectl` |
| `01-pods-and-lifecycle` | **Pods & Sidecars** | Pod manifests, init containers, sidecars, lifecycle phases (Pending, Running, CrashLoopBackOff) |
| `02-replica-sets-and-deployments` | **Deployments & Rollouts** | RollingUpdate vs Recreate, maxSurge, maxUnavailable, rollbacks (`kubectl rollout undo`) |
| `03-services-and-networking` | **Services & Discovery** | ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, ExternalName, kube-proxy iptables/IPVS, CoreDNS discovery |
| `04-ingress-and-gateway-api` | **Ingress & Gateway** | Ingress Controllers (NGINX/Traefik), TLS termination, Cert-Manager, Gateway API |
| `05-configmaps-and-secrets` | **Configuration & Secrets** | ConfigMaps, Opaque/TLS Secrets, base64 vs encryption-at-rest, external secret stores |
| `06-storage-pv-pvc-storageclasses` | **Persistent Storage** | StorageClasses, Dynamic Volume Provisioning, PVs, PVCs, access modes (RWO, RWX) |
| `07-statefulsets-and-headless-services` | **Stateful Workloads** | StatefulSets (Postgres/Kafka), deterministic hostnames (`pod-0`), headless services (`clusterIP: None`) |
| `08-daemonsets-and-jobs` | **DaemonSets & CronJobs** | DaemonSets (node agents), run-to-completion Jobs, scheduled CronJobs |
| `09-health-probes-and-lifecycle-hooks` | **Health Probes** | LivenessProbe, ReadinessProbe, StartupProbe, preStop graceful shutdown hooks |
| `10-resource-management-and-qos` | **Resource Requests & Limits**| CPU/Memory requests & limits, QoS classes (Guaranteed, Burstable, BestEffort), OOMKilled |
| `11-autoscaling-hpa-vpa-keda` | **Autoscaling** | Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA), Metrics Server, Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA), KEDA |
| `12-scheduling-taints-tolerations-affinity` | **Advanced Scheduling** | NodeSelector, NodeAffinity, PodAntiAffinity (topologyKey), Taints & Tolerations |
| `13-security-rbac-serviceaccounts` | **RBAC & Authorization** | ServiceAccounts, Roles, RoleBindings, ClusterRoles, ClusterRoleBindings, least privilege |
| `14-network-policies-and-cni` | **NetworkPolicies & CNI** | Ingress/Egress firewall rules, default-deny all, CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium eBPF) |
| `15-helm-package-management` | **Helm Chart Mastery** | Chart anatomy, `values.yaml`, Go template functions, `helm install/upgrade/rollback` |
| `16-crds-and-operator-pattern` | **CRDs & Operators** | Custom Resource Definitions, reconciliation control loop, Kubebuilder / Operator SDK |
| `17-monitoring-logging-observability` | **Observability** | Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Fluentbit/Loki, `kubectl top` |
| `18-interview-questions-and-drills` | **CKA/CKAD Master Drill** | Top 10 high-yield Kubernetes interview scenarios & troubleshooting commands |

---

```bash

kubectl get pods -w
```

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 00 - Kubernetes Cluster Architecture 🛠️

### 1. Control Plane Components:
- **kube-apiserver**: Front door of the cluster; exposes the Kubernetes REST API.
- **etcd**: Consistent, highly-available distributed key-value store for all cluster state.
- **kube-scheduler**: Watches for unscheduled Pods and selects nodes based on resources and affinity.
- **kube-controller-manager**: Runs core controllers (NodeController, DeploymentController, ReplicaSetController).
- **cloud-controller-manager**: Integrates with cloud provider APIs (LoadBalancers, routing, storage).

### 2. Worker Node Components:
- **kubelet**: Agent running on each node ensuring containers are running in Pods as described by PodSpecs.
- **kube-proxy**: Maintains network routing rules on nodes (iptables/IPVS) for Service traffic.
- **Container Runtime (CRI)**: `containerd` / `CRI-O` executing container images.

children.content:
# 01 - Pods & Lifecycle

- **Pod**: Smallest deployable unit in Kubernetes representing one or more co-located containers sharing network namespace (`localhost`) and storage volumes.
- **Phases**: `Pending` -> `Running` -> `Succeeded` / `Failed`.

children.name: deployment.yaml
children.content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web-deployment
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: nginx
          image: nginx:1.25-alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80

# 02 - Deployments & Rolling Updates

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 03 - Services & Networking

- **ClusterIP (Default)**: Exposes service on internal cluster IP.
- **NodePort**: Exposes service on each node's static port (`30000-32767`).
- **LoadBalancer**: Provisions cloud provider load balancer.
- **CoreDNS**: In-cluster DNS format `<service-name>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local`.

children.name: ingress.yaml
children.content:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: web-ingress
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target: /
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  rules:
    - host: app.example.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: web-service
                port:
                  number: 80

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 06 - Persistent Volumes & Claims

- **Access Modes**:
  - `ReadWriteOnce (RWO)`: Mounted by single node.
  - `ReadOnlyMany (ROX)`: Mounted read-only by multiple nodes.
  - `ReadWriteMany (RWX)`: Mounted read-write by multiple nodes (NFS, Ceph).

children.name: statefulset.yaml
children.content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: postgres-headless
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  selector:
    app: postgres
  ports:
    - port: 5432
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: postgres
spec:
  serviceName: postgres-headless
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: postgres
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: postgres
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: postgres:16-alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 5432
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              value: example
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: pgdata
      spec:
        accessModes: [ "ReadWriteOnce" ]
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 5Gi

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 09 - Health Probes (Liveness vs Readiness vs Startup)

- **Startup Probe**: Determines if application has initialized.
- **Liveness Probe**: Detects deadlocks; kubelet restarts container on failure.
- **Readiness Probe**: Checks if container is ready to accept traffic; removes from Service endpoints on failure.

children.name: README.md
children.content:
# 10 - Resource Requests, Limits & QoS Classes

1. **Guaranteed**: Requests == Limits for all CPU & Memory.
2. **Burstable**: Requests < Limits.
3. **BestEffort**: No requests or limits set (First to be evicted when node runs low on RAM).

children.name: hpa.yaml
children.content:
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: web-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: web-deployment
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 75

children.name: affinity.yaml
children.content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: anti-affinity-app
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
    spec:
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - labelSelector:
                matchExpressions:
                  - key: app
                    operator: In
                    values:
                      - api
              topologyKey: "kubernetes.io/hostname"
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: nginx:alpine

apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: app-reader-sa
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: pod-reader
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["pods"]
    verbs: ["get", "list", "watch"]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: read-pods-binding
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: app-reader-sa
roleRef:
    kind: Role
    name: pod-reader
    apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io

children.content:
# 18 - CKA / CKAD High-Yield Interview Scenarios 🎯

### Top 5 Troubleshooting Scenarios:
1. **CrashLoopBackOff**: Container starts and immediately exits (check `kubectl logs --previous` and `kubectl describe pod`).
2. **OOMKilled**: Container memory limit exceeded; increase memory limits or investigate memory leaks.
3. **ImagePullBackOff**: Typo in image name/tag, private registry credentials missing (`imagePullSecrets`).
4. **Pending Pod**: No node with enough CPU/memory requests, or node taints not tolerated.
5. **Service Endpoint Empty**: Selector labels on Service do not match labels in Pod template.
